title: Black-hole thermodynamics in doubly special relativity: near-horizon g/f temperature scaling under a shared operational scale
summary: Doubly Special Relativity (DSR) deforms special-relativistic kinematics by introducing an invariant Planck energy scale $E_{\mathrm{Pl}}$ alongside the speed of light, while preserving the relativity principle. A key issue in curved spacetimes, particularly black-hole thermodynamics, is the operational meaning of the ``energy'' in modified dispersion relations (MDRs).
